title: An incomplete empathy phrase

priorTranscript.text: Hi. Sorry — I already told the other doctor everything last night. Is this going to take long?

currentLearnerUtterance: I'm sorry that you had to

should: Treat the phrase as incomplete without filling in a new event.
A short acknowledgement or one gentle request to continue is reasonable.
mustNot: Do not fabricate what Dana supposedly had to do.
Do not launch an unrelated symptom or risk disclosure.
